answer_1.quote: We evaluate our implementation on datasets with an increasing number of utterances... XSum... ROCStories... DialogSum... DeliData... to assess its performance across various tasks.

answer_2.quote: We use ROUGE as the primary evaluation metric... We also evaluate the perplexity of generated text using GPT-2 Large... BLEU is used to compare input text with recovered text after encoding.

answer_3.quote: We employed Gemini-1.5 as an LLM-based evaluator. Using a carefully designed prompt, Gemini-1.5 provided fluency ratings for predictions from the XSum dataset, achieving high alignment with human annotators.

answer_4.quote: We recruited 5 participants to evaluate 25 dialogues generated by LD4LG, Flan-T5, and SLD... The evaluation process begins by assessing readability... criteria: Repetition, Fluency/Grammar, Coherence, Compatibility, Hallucination.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were given instructions and criteria (repetition, fluency, coherence, compatibility, hallucination) to score each generated text.
